name: juni
title: Juni
author: Muhammad Junaid Iftikhar
description: Basic Terminal.app, starship 🔥⬢📱 prompt, atuin history, autosuggestions, eza icons

prompt.starship:
format = "$directory on 🔥 $git_branch via ⬢ $nodejs on 📱 $username$character "

[directory]
truncation_length = 3
truncate_to_repo = true
style = "bold cyan"

[git_branch]
style = "bold purple"
format = "$branch "

[nodejs]
style = "bold green"
format = "v$version "

[username]
show_always = true
style_user = "bold purple"
format = "$user"

[character]
success_symbol = "❯"
error_symbol = "❯"
